articles.title: US voices concern over China's intercontinental range missile test
articles.summary: The US expressed strong concern over China's recent test launch of a nuclear-capable missile, viewing it as a destabilizing act. Washington simultaneously reassured its allies of its unwavering defense commitments, especially in the Indo-Pacific. This incident underscores rising geopolitical tensions and the ongoing strategic competition between the two powers, impacting regional security dynamics and highlighting the arms race.

articles.title: Skyroot Aerospace: building the Uber for space, one launch at a time
articles.summary: Mission Aagaman, a rocket launch by Skyroot Aerospace, marks a historic milestone as India's first private space mission. Set for liftoff post-July 12th, it signifies the burgeoning private sector's role in space exploration. This initiative underscores India's growing scientific and technological prowess, fostering indigenous innovation and contributing to national self-reliance in advanced domains.

articles.title: Chinese nuclear capable missile appears to land close to Nauru, Tuvalu
articles.summary: China recently conducted a significant test-firing of a nuclear-capable missile from a submarine, showcasing its advanced naval capabilities. The missile's trajectory reportedly crossed multiple Pacific nations before impacting waters near Tuvalu's Exclusive Economic Zone. This demonstration highlights China's expanding strategic reach and military power, raising regional security implications and underscoring its role in international defence dynamics.
